Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Glow plugs

  • Fault: The vehicle exhibits a significant drop in performance; the engine fault warning light (red) is illuminated with the corresponding system fault warning on the instrument panel.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0380 (Pre-heater 1 Timing Control - Malfunction)

  • Cause: Faulty glow plugs

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the glow plugs and replace them if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, all glow plugs were replaced to maintain consistent performance and avoid variations in output.
